decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is a renamed and already well-received BASIC 518 with strong public commitment and sunk investments, making escalation-driven persistence very likely.
Its dedicated product page for a multi-model line signals visible commitment and development costs, so management continues despite any early disappointments.

The stationary electric fine shredder addresses a niche but has sunk engineering and launch costs, and responsibility for it makes dropping unlikely within one year.
As a green-waste-specific grinder line, it fits the announced resource-saving direction and early weak results are attributed to temporary causes, so management persists.
